body.message:
Please note that, unfortunately, we do not provide Ejari contracts.

However, if you wish to continue your stay with us, we would be happy to share the available rates for a 6-month stay. To secure and block the unit for the full 6-month period, the first and last month’s rent would need to be paid in advance.

If you wish to continue on a monthly basis after the initial period, this can be arranged subject to availability at the time of renewal.

Please let us know if you would like us to share the 6-month rate with you, and we will be happy to assist you further.
